summary: The main article describes a nickel-catalyzed enantioselective photoredox reaction using a Ni-DBFOX complex as a bifunctional catalyst. It includes 1 table for optimization, 1 scheme for the proposed mechanism, and 8 figures/schemes detailing substrate scope and synthetic applications.

items.caption: Previous strategies for enantioselective radical conjugate additions and that developed in this study.
items.description: Comparison between previous dual-catalyst systems and the current bifunctional nickel catalyst approach for radical additions.
